## v0.30.0 - 2026.10.29

This is the stable release of vLLM Ascend v0.30.0, built on the v0.29 release line and aligned with upstream vLLM v0.30.0 via the main2main pipeline. Building on v0.30.0rc1, this release integrates FlashMLA decode with DCP and DSpark, extends KV Pool layerwise pooling and PCP speculative decoding, hardens EPLB for the new quantization formats, and fixes the stability issues across attention, MoE, KV transfer, and Model Runner V2 execution reported during the RC cycle. It still focuses on the flagship models: DeepSeek V4.1, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-27B, DeepSeek V4-Flash/Pro, Kimi K3.   * Qwen3.8-27B: Supported non-contiguous KV cache in hybrid linear-attention models, respected per-layer KV cache dtype and kept KV cache contiguous for paged attention, restored C8 V scales on hybrid cache page reassignment, restored Mamba block tables before deferred PP postprocessing, added the FLA NPU backend for GDN prefill, and fixed 310P performance and kernel compatibility for quantized deployment. #14340 #17924 #18003 #17956 #17954 #17565 #17534 #16420 #17964 #17278†
  * Kimi K3 on Ascend: Added end-to-end Kimi K3 support, including MLA DSpark speculative decoding, no-RoPE MLAPO on Ascend 950, fused QKV projections, fused norm gate and attention residual, EPLB, MegaMoE, and projector rotation. #12950 #13277 #13507 #13989 #13509 #14231†
  * GLM-5.2 / DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 / DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 accuracy and performance: Resolved GLM-5.2 DSpark acceptance regressions and DeepSeek V4 Flash-0731 / Pro-0813 accuracy issues (reasoning-effort alignment, routed SwiGLU limit, and frontend behavior), and reused DSV4 compressor metadata across layers for better performance. #12262 #13531 #13993 #14074 #14397 #14624 #14994†
  * Deprecation cleanup: Removed layer sharding, FlashComm2, multistream overlap gate, dynamic-batch SLO, weight prefetch, matmul all-reduce fusions, and kv offload in KV Pool to streamline the codebase. #11953 #12117 #11956 #11933 #11949 #12119 #11904†
  * FlashMLA decode: Integrated FlashMLA decode with DCP and DSpark, routed strided MLA cache writes through PROLOG_V3, used native GatherPa for strided MLA cache reads, enabled no-RoPE MLAPO for token-fused FlashMLA, and skipped FlashMLA CPU length synchronization under DCP. #18758 #18682 #19151 #19155 #19115 #19038
  * KV Pool: Added global layer-window prefetch for layerwise loads, GLM-5.3-Flash Mooncake layerwise support, and Triton KeyPool cache adapters; supported packed SFA C8 layerwise transfer, and reduced lookup/reachable-mask and page-table overhead. #18975 #18749 #18296 #18716 #18837 #18576 #18245
  * MoE: Backported Kimi K3 MegaMoE routed dimensions, integrated the `mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla` operator for the DeepSeek-V4 FP8 KV path, fused shared W8A8 MXFP activation quantization, and used BF16 router GEMM with FP32 accumulation. #18976 #18808 #18678 #18820
  * PCP & speculative decoding: Supported PCP with PIECEWISE and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs, fixed-K speculative decode request sharding in PCP, and speculative decoding in KVPP. #18365 #18312 #18334
  * EPLB: Supported Kimi K3 and its MTP draft model and w8a8_mxfp8 on A5, and hardened staging-buffer fencing, HIXL registration ranges, and expert weight updates. #18261 [#18436](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascen...

# Qwen3.5-397B-A17B

## 1 Introduction

!!! note
    
    `The "PD Separation Deployment" mentioned in this document is provided only as an example/reference design to demonstrate the basic process of deploying Prefill and Decode in separated mode. It is not recommended for use in the production environment.
    
    **For the production environment on the customer side, [MindIE Motor](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/mindie/latest/quickstart/docs/en/user_guide/quick_start.md) + vLLM-Ascend is recommended.**
    `

Qwen3.5-397B-A17B is a large-scale Qwen3.5 MoE model that combines multimodal capability, long-context inference, MTP speculative decoding, and W8A8 quantized deployment for production serving on Ascend hardware.

This document describes the main validation steps for the model, including supported features, prerequisites, installation, single-node online deployment, multi-node deployment, Prefill-Decode (PD) disaggregation, functional verification, accuracy and performance evaluation, performance tuning, and FAQs.
For performance tests, set `--max-num-seqs * --data-parallel-size` greater than or equal to the test concurrency.
  * `--max-num-batched-tokens` is the maximum number of tokens processed in one scheduler step. A larger value can improve prefill efficiency but consumes more activation memory.
  * `--gpu-memory-utilization` controls how much HBM vLLM can use to calculate KV cache capacity. A higher value increases KV cache size but can trigger OOM if runtime memory is higher than the profile run.
  * `--enable-prefix-caching` enables prefix caching. For Qwen3.5, short prefixes may not be cached when the hybrid KV cache manager adjusts the block size to a large value.
  * `--quantization ascend` enables Ascend quantization for the quantized weights used above. Remove this option when deploying the BF16 model.
  * `--speculative-config` enables Qwen3.5 MTP speculative decoding. Reduce `num_speculative_tokens` or remove this option if the workload is sensitive to first-token latency or if MTP is unstable in your environment.
  * `--compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'` enables full decode ACLGraph replay to reduce dispatch overhead.
  * `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0` selects Model Runner V1 for the single-node examples above.
  * `--additional-config` configures Ascend-specific optimizations: `enable_cpu_binding=true` enables Ascend-native CPU binding; `enable_fused_mc2=1` selects dispatch-FFN-combine and is used by the single-node 950DT and A3 examples for compatibility with the documented MTP and batching configurations; `2` selects CANN MegaMoe and should only be enabled with a matching CANN/operator stack and supported token-shape limits; `0` disables the fused path. `enable_flashcomm1=true` enables MoE sequence parallelism across TP ranks and requires `--enable-expert-parallel` with a TP size greater than 1.
